title: Upon shed
subtitle: 日常生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）
meta: 主题语境：日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）　|　核心词汇：upon　|　正文 353 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 upon 的含义与所引出的成分，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1984 the elder kept the staff ① upon the morning of the fair at the gate, and everybody in the village said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three years on, people still spoke of that morning: the staff had been left ② upon the wall of the shed, and nobody had asked a single question. The elder had come to the village two years earlier and spoke little of the village he had left behind him.

The memoir for November 1978 puts it plainer. It was done ③ upon the word of the doctor, and the youth who kept the staff had kept it ④ upon the shoulder of his father twice before the winter came; nothing in the village was ever done upon the word of the doctor in those days. The youth wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every year thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the staff at the far gate, meant something else. He said the whole business had begun ⑤ upon the sight of the letter, and that nobody in his family had ever done it ⑥ upon the head of the child; he was not a man who explained himself, and the village had long since stopped asking him to.

By 1991 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the memoir. What the line asked for was that the staff be kept ⑦ upon the back of the cart, and that the names be written ⑧ upon the cover of the book. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did; everybody there knew the work had been carried upon the back of the cart.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1994 she kept the staff ⑨ upon the morning of the fair again when nobody else would, and ⑩ upon the wall of the shed, she said in 1996, that was the part nobody forgot. She kept the staff in the same gate for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the village never forgot what had been done upon the wall of the shed.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. prep. 在…上（表时间：upon the morning of the fair）
B. prep. 在…上（表处所：upon the wall of the shed）
C. prep. 一…就（表方式／状态：upon the word of the doctor）
D. prep. 一…就（引出施动者或相关的人：be kept upon the shoulder of his father）
E. prep. 在…上（表原因：upon the sight of the letter）
F. prep. 一…就（表对象／目的：upon the head of the child）
G. prep. 在…上（表工具／材料：upon the back of the cart）
H. prep. 一…就（表载体／处所：written upon the cover of the book）

items.q: upon the morning of the fair
upon the wall of the shed
upon the word of the doctor
upon the shoulder of his father
upon the sight of the letter
upon the head of the child
upon the back of the cart
upon the cover of the book
upon the morning of the fair again
upon the wall of the shed, she said

answers.why: upon 意为“在…上”，此处引出时间 the morning of the fair（集市那天早晨），说明那件短短的拐杖是在何时留下的。
upon 意为“在…上”，此处引出处所 the wall of the shed（棚屋的墙上），说明东西被放在何处。
upon 意为“一…就”，此处引出方式或状态 the word of the doctor（大夫的一句话），说明这件事是怎么做成的。
upon 意为“一…就”，此处引出施动者或相关的人 他父亲的肩上：be kept upon the shoulder of his father。
upon 意为“在…上”，此处引出原因 the sight of the letter（一见到那封信），说明整件事由何而起。
upon 意为“一…就”，此处引出对象或目的 the head of the child（孩子的头上）。
upon 意为“在…上”，此处引出工具或材料 the back of the cart（车板上面）。
upon 意为“一…就”，此处引出载体 the cover of the book（书的封面上）：names written upon the cover of the book。
upon 意为“在…上”，1994 年母亲在无人肯做时又留下了那件短短的拐杖，此处仍引出时间 the morning of the fair。
upon 意为“在…上”，母亲 1996 年那句话引出的仍是那一处棚屋的墙上。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1984 年集市那天早晨前后，长者把那件短短的拐杖留在了村口。（upon the morning of the fair）
那件短短的拐杖被放在棚屋的墙上，谁也没有过问。（upon the wall of the shed）
整件事是大夫的一句话做成的，回忆录上写得明白。（upon the word of the doctor）
入冬之前，那件短短的拐杖已经由他父亲的肩上守着过两回。（be kept upon the shoulder of his father）
叔叔说，整件事是由一见到那封信起的。（upon the sight of the letter）
他说，家里从来没有人为孩子的头上做过这件事。（upon the head of the child）
answers: In 1984 the elder kept the staff upon the morning of the fair at the gate.
The staff had been left upon the wall of the shed, and nobody asked a single question.
It was done upon the word of the doctor, or so the memoir says.
The staff had been kept upon the shoulder of his father twice before the winter came.
He said the whole business had begun upon the sight of the letter.
He said nobody in his family had ever done it upon the head of the child.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作

answers: In 1984 the elder kept the staff upon the morning of the fair, and nobody forgot it.
The staff had been left upon the wall of the shed for three years.
The work was done upon the word of the doctor, as it always was in those days.
The staff had been kept upon the shoulder of his father twice before the winter came.
My mother kept the staff upon the morning of the fair again when nobody else would.
The whole village never forgot what had been done upon the wall of the shed.
